quality.name: CompoundTune_Discovery200_q2.8_Layer_C8_Cap2_v1
quality.scope: This gate compares actual natural outputs with the frozen BI0 single-GPU reference. It does not prove KV correctness. Its request-cluster CI is not a server-start performance CI.

metrics.name: CompoundTune_Discovery200_q2.8_Layer_C8_Cap2_v1
metrics.token_delivery_scope: Client-visible co-delivered tokens have zero interval. No per-token GPU generation timestamp is inferred.
metrics.arrival_rate_definition: actual_arrival_QPS is the realized scheduled Poisson-trace rate. actual_dispatch_QPS uses coordinator enqueue timestamps. TTFT includes dispatch lag.
metrics.timing_scope: Scheduled open-loop arrival to coordinator delivery. No HTTP. First Native interval includes KV handoff if P first token is reused.
